shortDescription: Novo Nordisk OMXCOP:NOVO_B aims to launch more than five blockbuster drugs by 2030 and to deliver more than 150 billion Danish crowns ($23 billion) in pipeline sales in 2035, its CEO Mike Doustdar said at a Capital Markets Day in London.($1 = 6.5096 Danish crowns)
